test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 17 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

These kinds of stories are written by Peter.

options.text: Peter writes these kinds of stories.
Peter has written these kinds of stories.
Peter can write these kinds of stories.
Peter write these kinds of stories.

solution:
"The correct answer is **'Option 1'"**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence "These kinds of stories are written by Peter." is in passive voice.
 
• In active voice, the subject of the sentence must be doing the action (here "Peter" is the subject).
 
• Out of all the given options, option 1 "Peter writes these kinds of stories." is the only one that correctly changes the passive voice to active voice, with "Peter" being the subject who is performing the action.
 
• The verb tense is kept consistent (i.e., present simple tense).

Therefore, the correct answer is **"Option 1."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] 

**Additional Information__**

 
• Option 2: "Peter has written these kinds of stories." This is also in active voice but the tense has changed from simple present to present perfect, which is not the intent.
 
• Option 3: "Peter can write these kinds of stories." This statement is again active but changes the meaning as it is expressing Peter's ability to write these stories.
 
• Option 4: "Peter write these kinds of stories." This is grammatically incorrect as it lacks the proper verb conjugation for the third person singular subject.
